actions.title: Raise the wiper arm away from the windshield
actions.instruction: Lift the wiper arm away from the windshield far enough to work on the blade.
actions.warning_text: Do not allow the spring-loaded wiper arm to snap back against the windshield.

actions.title: Lift the blade's primary locking clip
actions.instruction: Lift the primary locking clip on the wiper-blade connector.

actions.title: Press the secondary locking clip
actions.instruction: Press the secondary locking clip to release the blade from the arm.

actions.title: Remove the old wiper blade
actions.instruction: Slide the released blade from the wiper arm.

actions.title: Install and lock the replacement blade
actions.instruction: Install the replacement blade in the reverse order and confirm both locking features are fully engaged.

actions.title: Lower the wiper arm carefully
actions.instruction: Lower the wiper arm gently to the windshield and verify the blade is secure before operating the wipers.
